name: Securities Financing Reporting Transaction Status Advice V 02
definition: The SecuritiesFinancingReportingTransactionStatusAdvice message is sent by the trade repository (TR) to the authority or made available to the report submitting entity and the reporting counterparty as well as the entity responsible for reporting, if applicable, identifying the transactions rejected and the reasons for a rejection.

TransactionReportStatusAndReason.name: Transaction Report Status And Reason
TransactionReportStatusAndReason.definition: Provides the status and reason of the transaction report advice.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
